QuestInfo.name: Spiegelmann and Horntail?!
QuestInfo.0: You found an Old Picture of Spiegelmann in an Old Envelope in the Monster Park. Go ask Spiegelmann about it.
QuestInfo.1: You found an Old Picture of Spiegelmann in an Old Envelope in the Monster Park. Go ask Spiegelmann about it.
QuestInfo.2: You picked up an Old Picture in the Monster Park. It was a picture of Spiegelmann smiling on top of Horntail's head. How could he get a picture with Horntail? Just who is Spiegelmann?

0.0: You must really enjoy the Monster Park, eh? What can I do for you?\r\n#L0##bI found an Old Picture inside the Old Envelope you were looking for. It's a picture of you and Horntail.#l\n#k
0.1: What was that? A picture of me and Horntail, you say... Give me a minute. I'm going to have to search my memory for this...

1.0: Oh, er, THAT picture. Heh, yes, that's me. Surprised at my bravery in facing Horntail?\r\n#L0##bOh, no. I'm not falling for that. Just who are you, really? What were you doing with Horntail?#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, there's nothing to fall for. When I was young, I was quite the adventurer, and traveled all over Maple World battling monsters. I tried to take on Horntail, but as you can see, I failed to defeat him. There's your story. Now, off with you. I have lots to do.
